gate: parsing must not drop sustained ingest below 5,000 msg/sec (TESTING_STANDARDS.md §5, PHASE_03)

pure_parse_extract.description: RFC 5424/3164 parse + vendor extraction over a 12-message mixed corpus, every message unique, no I/O

end_to_end_pipeline.probe: tests/VSoftSol.Syslog.Benchmarks -- --ingest-probe   (warmed, 200,000 frames, real channel + spill + parse + SQLite)
end_to_end_pipeline.note: worst case: 200k unique messages ALL matching cisco-ios (the pack with the most stages), on the 2-vCPU VMware dev VM
end_to_end_pipeline.verdict: PASS (marginal). Clears the 5,000 gate in every run (5,100-5,900). RFC-parse-only path is 13,604 msg/sec — faster than the Phase 2 baseline of 11,460, so RFC parsing added no regression.

phase2_regression_check.verdict: RFC parsing: no regression (+19%). Vendor extraction: -54% worst case on a 2-vCPU VM. Documented (known-issues P3-2), re-verified on Phase 12 hardware. Mitigation: Parsing:VendorExtractionEnabled toggle + the Phase 2 per-source rate limiter.

raw_retention.verdict: PASS — raw_message byte-identical to input for 100% of fixtures, parsed or not, and for 32k FsCheck / random cases
